citation: Brehm A, Liu Y, Sheikh A, et al. Additive loss-of-function proteasome subunit mutations in CANDLE/PRAAS patients promote type I IFN production. J Clin Invest. 2015. doi:10.1172/JCI81260.
description: Identified PSMB4 loss-of-function alleles in proteasome-associated autoinflammatory disease and showed that proteasome-subunit mutations or siRNA depletion impair proteasome assembly and activity. The paper supplies the direct PSMB4-to-proteasome-dysfunction link used for Psmb4 pairs with proteasome-stress signatures.

citation: Willemsen N, Arigoni I, Studencka-Turski M, Kruger E, Bartelt A. Proteasome dysfunction disrupts adipogenesis and induces inflammation via ATF3. Mol Metab. 2022;62:101518. doi:10.1016/j.molmet.2022.101518.
description: Used Psmb4 siRNA in mouse brown adipocytes and found reduced proteasome function, Nfe2l1-mediated proteostasis compensation, and increased Atf3/stress markers. This directly supports the direction that Psmb4 loss should elicit proteasome recovery and stress transcripts, albeit outside neurons.

citation: Montenegro-Venegas C, Fienko S, Anni D, et al. Bassoon inhibits proteasome activity via interaction with PSMB4. Cell Mol Life Sci. 2020. doi:10.1007/s00018-020-03590-z.
description: Showed that the presynaptic scaffold Bassoon directly interacts with PSMB4-containing 20S proteasomes and modulates neuronal proteasomal activity and synaptic substrate abundance. This gives a neuron-specific partial bridge between PSMB4 proteasome disruption and synaptic-proteome changes.

citation: Funasaka T, Tsuka E, Wong RW. Regulation of autophagy by nucleoporin Tpr. Sci Rep. 2012;2:878. doi:10.1038/srep00878.
description: Demonstrated that Tpr knockdown reduces nuclear pore number and affects HSP70/HSF1 mRNA export, p53 trafficking with CRM1, and autophagy. It supports a target-specific but indirect link from Tpr loss to nuclear transport and stress-control phenotypes.

citation: Chen M, Long Q, Borrie MS, et al. Nucleoporin TPR promotes tRNA nuclear export and protein synthesis in lung cancer cells. PLoS Genet. 2021;17:e1009899. doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1009899.
description: Showed that TPR knockdown inhibits tRNA nuclear export and protein synthesis, extending TPR function beyond structural nuclear pores. The result is target-specific support for nucleocytoplasmic transport and RNA-related consequences of Tpr perturbation.

citation: Coyle JH, Bor YC, Rekosh D, Hammarskjold ML. The Tpr protein regulates export of mRNAs with retained introns that traffic through the Nxf1 pathway. RNA. 2011;17:1344-1356. doi:10.1261/rna.2616111.
description: Showed that Tpr restricts export and expression of incompletely spliced NXF1-pathway mRNAs. This is a specific bridge from Tpr loss to RNA-processing and export phenotypes, but not to the exact gene-wise directions in the screen.

citation: Yap K, Lim ZQ, Khandelia P, Friedman B, Makeyev EV. Coordinated regulation of neuronal mRNA steady-state levels through developmentally controlled intron retention. Genes Dev. 2012;26:1209-1223. doi:10.1101/gad.188037.112.
description: Found that nuclear RNA surveillance involving Tpr helps clear retained-intron transcripts from neuron-specific genes during differentiation. It provides neuron-relevant support for a Tpr-to-RNA-surveillance bridge in broad Tpr response pairs.

citation: Wang Y, Duan W, Li H, et al. Ppp2r1a haploinsufficiency increases excitatory synaptic transmission and decreases spatial learning by impairing endocannabinoid signaling. J Clin Invest. 2025. doi:10.1172/JCI185602.
description: Showed that heterozygous Ppp2r1a deletion in forebrain excitatory neurons alters synaptic strength through reduced 2-arachidonoyl glycerol and increased MAGL transcription. This is direct target-specific neuronal evidence for synaptic/endocannabinoid consequences, but it does not document the transcript modules observed here.

citation: Kins S, Kurosinski P, Nitsch RM, Gotz J. Activation of the ERK and JNK signaling pathways caused by neuron-specific inhibition of PP2A in transgenic mice. Am J Pathol. 2003;163:833-843. doi:10.1016/S0002-9440(10)63444-X.
description: Showed that chronic neuron-specific PP2A inhibition activates ERK and JNK signaling and increases nuclear c-Jun. It gives a PP2A-level, directionally positive bridge to Jun induction after Ppp2r1a perturbation, but not a PPP2R1A-specific transcriptomic prediction.

citation: Yang G, Wang Y, Yuan H, et al. Succinylation of tumor suppressor PPP2R1A K541 by HAT1 converses the role in modulation of gluconeogenesis/lipogenesis remodeling to display oncogene function. Acta Pharm Sin B. 2025. doi:10.1016/j.apsb.2025.07.040.
description: Reported that HAT1-mediated PPP2R1A modification blocks PP2A holoenzyme assembly and promotes SREBP1 nuclear accumulation and lipogenic expression in liver cancer. This provides a PPP2R1A-to-lipid-metabolism bridge for Insig1/Sqle/Msmo1/Dhcr24 increases, but the pathway, tissue, and SREBP branch are indirect.
